title: Congestion Games with Heterogeneous Valuations: An Optimal Transport Approach
abstract: arXiv:2607.03625v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In emerging urban mobility and logistics applications, such as advanced air mobility, electric vehicle charging, and shared service systems, agents with heterogeneous valuations choose among multiple outcomes while sharing congested resources. Existing congestion game and resource-allocation models, however, typically restrict either the structure of heterogeneous outcome preferences or the form of congestion externalities. We introduce a nonatomic congestion game framework in which agents have multidimensional heterogeneous valuations over a finite set of outcomes, with the population represented by a measure over the valuation space. We show that, although there is a continuum of heterogeneous agents, both Nash equilibria and social optima admit finite-dimensional characterizations. translated_title: 具有异质性估值的拥塞博弈：一种最优传输方法
translated_abstract: 在新兴的城市出行和物流应用中，例如先进空中交通、电动汽车充电和共享服务系统，具有异质性估值的智能体在共享拥塞资源的同时在多个结果之间进行选择。然而，现有的拥塞博弈和资源分配模型通常要么限制异质性结果偏好的结构，要么限制拥塞外部性的形式。我们引入了一个非原子拥塞博弈框架，其中智能体对有限的结果集合具有多维异质性估值，且总体人群由估值空间上的测度来表示。我们证明，尽管存在连续统的异质性智能体，纳什均衡和社会最优均可以由有限维进行刻画。纳什均衡由总流量和结果层面的阈值向量来刻画，而社会最优则具有半离散最优传输形式。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于最优传输理论的非原子拥塞博弈框架，用于处理具有多维异质性估值的智能体，并证明了尽管存在连续统的异质性智能体，纳什均衡和社会最优均可获得有限维刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a nonatomic congestion game framework based on optimal transport for agents with multidimensional heterogeneous valuations, proving that both Nash equilibria and social optima admit finite-dimensional characterizations despite a continuum of heterogeneous agents.
